passage.text: Winter break begins, and snow covers Karasuki. Booha and Mimo make a snowman and ride a sled. Nuppi goes ice skating, then everyone drinks hot cocoa under the holiday lights. At Christmas, they decorate a tree. On New Year's Eve, they stay awake until midnight. On New Year's Day, they visit a shrine with their family. It is cold outside, but the holiday feels warm and happy.

passage.text: Every year, Mister Happy has a family celebration. His grandparents come for a family dinner. Everyone brings special food, and Nuppi makes a cake. Mimo plays music, and the family sings a song. After dinner, they play a game and take a photo. Booha gives his grandparents a card. Their smiles make it a happy memory and an important family tradition.

passage.text: Booha wants to thank Nuppi for her kindness. He gets a book and toy as presents. Mimo helps him put them in a box and wrap it. They add a bright ribbon and place the box in a gift bag. Booha writes a letter and thank-you card. Nuppi is surprised when she receives the presents. She says thank you and gives everyone a big smile.

passage.text: Booha thinks about this year. His favorite activity was reading with a friend. A difficult lesson was a challenge, but his teacher helped him. Booha made mistakes and learned from them. He feels proud of his success and improvement. Next year, his goal is to learn a new skill and read more books. He writes the goal down so he will remember it.
